summary: Shell-shape measurements for fossil ammonoids are open (Dryad Westermann Morphospace, CC0, an XLS appendix of 144,384 bytes; further Zenodo tables on Viséan ammonoids seen in search), and occurrences with ages are open (PBDB Ammonoidea: 94,568 occurrences). No independent ammonoid phylogeny is available through Open Tree of Life (Ammonoidea is an extinct, incertae sedis taxonomy entry), and MorphoSource holds only one ammonoid mesh. I did not open the Dryad XLS, so whether spiral angle or whorl expansion is a column is unconfirmed.
next_step: Open the Westermann appendix and the Viséan-ammonoid Zenodo tables to list columns; for the phylogeny side, take published cladograms built without coiling characters, or use extant Nautilus/Spirula/Sepia placements on the Open Tree for a restricted-scope test.
obstacles_confirmed: Independent fossil phylogenies remain uncertain; ammonoid cladograms have often used coiling.
Shell meshes for measuring the angle are rare in MorphoSource.
